# Daily Science News

> Daily Science News (https://sciencenewshub.click) is an authoritative digital publication delivering verified, peer-reviewed scientific discoveries, space exploration missions, physics breakthroughs, biotechnology advancements, and healthcare research.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://sciencenewshub.click/): The main landing page featuring latest discoveries and breaking scientific news.
- [About Us](https://sciencenewshub.click/about): Editorial board, founder biography, mission statement, and E-E-A-T credentials.
- [Contact Us](https://sciencenewshub.click/contact): Direct editorial contact methods, inquiry forms, and communications.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sciencenewshub.click/privacy-policy): GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, and Google AdSense cookie compliance disclosures.
- [Terms of Service](https://sciencenewshub.click/terms): User agreement and intellectual property guidelines.
- [Website Disclaimer](https://sciencenewshub.click/disclaimer): Medical and scientific reporting disclaimers.
- [Science Blog](https://sciencenewshub.click/blog): In-depth research commentary and academic analysis.

## Scientific Categories
- [Space News](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/space): Astrophysics, NASA, ESA, JWST discoveries, and planetary science.
- [Physics Discoveries](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/physics): Quantum computing, particle physics, CERN LHC, and theoretical models.
- [Technology & AI](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/technology): Artificial intelligence, biotechnology, satellite networks, and computing.
- [Health & Medicine](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/health): Cellular longevity, microbiome research, neurobiology, and precision medicine.
- [Environment & Climate](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/environment): Earth systems, ocean currents, AMOC monitoring, and climate research.
- [Biology & Nature](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/biology): Genetics, evolutionary biology, zoology, and ecology.
- [Archaeology & Paleontology](https://sciencenewshub.click/category/archaeology): Fossil discoveries, ancient human history, and prehistoric excavations.

## Featured Research Reports
- [Honor Humanoid Robot Smashes Usain Bolt Record](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/honor-humanoid-robot-beats-usain-bolt-100m-record): Analysis of the 9.32-second 100m sprint and 2.88m high jump world records set at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.
- [Elon Musk Starship Flight 14 Update](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/elon-musk-spacex-starship-flight-14-launch-delay): Analysis of SpaceX scaling back upper-stage tower catch, September launch date, Flight 13 recovery at Christmas Island, and NASA Artemis 3 implications.
- [August 2026 Lunar Eclipse Blood Moon Guide](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/august-2026-lunar-eclipse-blood-moon-guide): Visibility footprint, 96.2% umbral peak times, NASA livestreams, and future Sri Lanka astronomical schedule.
- [Cellular Rejuvenation and Longevity](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/cellular-health-science-longevity-breakthroughs): Peer-reviewed geroscience on telomeres, senolytics, autophagy, and NAD+ metabolism.
- [Gut-Brain Axis and Mental Health](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/gut-brain-connection-microbiome-health-science): Neurobiological pathways between the enteric nervous system, microbiome, and cognitive resilience.
- [AI in Health Science & Precision Medicine](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/ai-in-health-science-precision-medicine): Deep learning, AlphaFold molecular pharmacology, and personalized oncology.
- [Ultra-Processed Foods & Metabolic Health](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/food-science-ultra-processed-foods-metabolic-health): Food matrix alterations, industrial emulsifiers, and insulin resistance studies.
- [First-Ever Black Hole Star Discovery](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/first-ever-black-hole-star-discovered-james-webb-space-telescope): James Webb Space Telescope observations of quasi-star stellar physics.
- [SpaceX AI Starmind Satellite Network](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/spacex-massive-shift-artificial-intelligence-starmind-satellites-2026): Orbital computational clusters and space-based artificial intelligence.
- [Total Solar Eclipse August 2026](https://sciencenewshub.click/article/total-solar-eclipse-august-2026-greenland-iceland-spain): Astronomical path of totality across Europe and the Arctic.
